# runr_topic (Resource)

A fan-out topic of the organization ([topics](https://runr.sh/docs/triggers/#topics)): an event published to it (`runr topics publish`, `POST /api/topics/{topic}/publish`) reaches every project with a `topic` trigger on it (`runr_project.triggers`). The region needs Redis. A topic with subscribing triggers cannot be destroyed: remove the triggers first.

Import: `terraform import runr_topic.orders orders` (name or id).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "runr_topic" "orders" {
  name        = "orders"
  region_id   = data.runr_region.eu.id
  description = "Every order event"
}

# A project subscribes to it with a topic trigger.
resource "runr_project" "billing" {
  name      = "billing"
  type      = "faas"
  runtime   = "python"
  region_id = data.runr_region.eu.id

  triggers = [
    { name = "orders", type = "topic", config = jsonencode({ topic = runr_topic.orders.name }) },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique in the organization (letters, digits and `. _ -`, at most 100). Changing it creates a new topic.
- `region_id` (String) Region whose Redis carries the topic. Changing it creates a new topic.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free text (at most 500 characters).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Topic id.
- `stream` (String) The topic's Redis stream.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A topic is imported by name or id.
terraform import runr_topic.orders orders
```
